card.name: Scattered web-page filler words
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted web-page words such as 'to' in a disclaimer, 'Results' in a search header, 'Contents' after 'Table of', 'made' in 'What made you want to look up', and digits inside ISBNs or phone numbers.
